verdict.rationale: A password manager could plausibly offer AI-generated insights from vault data, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no such feature. Pass Monitor provides rule-based password-health and breach checks with no mention of AI. Proton Sentinel uses AI for account-takeover protection, not for insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data, so it is only an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
